import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Reproduces Teradata-style QUALIFY semantics:
    - Filters WHERE amount > 100
    - Computes size_band CASE expression
    - Applies QUALIFY: keeps only ROW_NUMBER() = 1 per account_id
      (partitioned by account_id, ordered by txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC)
    """
    acct_txn = inputs["acct_txn"].copy()
    
    # WHERE amount > 100
    acct_txn = acct_txn[acct_txn["amount"] > 100]
    
    # Add size_band column
    acct_txn["size_band"] = acct_txn["amount"].apply(
        lambda x: "JUMBO" if x >= 1000 else ("LARGE" if x >= 500 else "STANDARD")
    )
    
    # QUALIFY: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC) = 1
    acct_txn["rn"] = acct_txn.groupby("account_id", sort=False).cumcount()
    # Sort within each group by txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC, then assign row numbers
    acct_txn = acct_txn.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
        kind="stable"
    )
    acct_txn["rn"] = acct_txn.groupby("account_id", sort=False).cumcount()
    
    # Keep only rows where rn == 0 (which is ROW_NUMBER() = 1 in SQL)
    acct_txn = acct_txn[acct_txn["rn"] == 0]
    
    # Drop the helper column
    acct_txn = acct_txn.drop(columns=["rn"])
    
    # Select final columns in order
    result = acct_txn[["account_id", "txn_id", "txn_ts", "amount", "channel", "size_band"]]
    
    return {"latest_high_value_txn": result}
